entities.summary: Maratha, a notable figure in the history of India, associated with Maratha and Sikh Empires (1674–1818). Preceded by Shivaji crowned as Chhatrapati, founding the Maratha Empire. Their legacy influenced Third Battle of Panipat — Ahmad Shah Durrani defeats the Maratha Confederacy and Maharaja Ranjit Singh captures Lahore and founds the Sikh Empire.
